assets.label: Velo Orange Enterprise front wheel — generated appearance approximation
assets.origin: Generated appearance approximation, using product references; not a manufacturer photograph.

references.role: Complete front wheel; manufacturer product image pixels inspected.

outerRim.method: Radial outer-alpha boundary samples (>230) every 2 degrees and least-squares circle fit

geometry.orientation: Near-circular side-on source. Rim/spokes/front hub only; no tyre.

limitations: Axle is about 20 pixels below the fitted circle centre; application may use a calibrated source axle offset.
Front wheel reference only. Reuse as a rear wheel must be labelled illustrative; the correct rear hub/freehub and dish are not depicted.
Spoke count/lacing and logo omissions are visual approximations; manufacturer size variant is not established from the reference pixels.

assets.label: ENE Ciclo silver double — generated foreshortened appearance approximation
assets.origin: Generated appearance approximation, using product references; not a manufacturer photograph.

references.role: Manufacturer assembled drive-side crank reference. Extra loose components intentionally excluded; pixels inspected.

outerRing.method: Visual tooth-tip circle estimate; tooth tips and gaps vary.

pedalEye.method: Transparent inner-eye connected-component bounding box centre

geometry.orientation: Drive-side, arm upper right. Whole-raster angle can be adjusted in app.

limitations: The deliberately shortened arm is a visual fit for a foreshortened photograph, not actual ENE mechanical geometry.
Exact reference ring tooth count and arm-length variant are unresolved.
Spindle and approximate tooth-tip circle are slightly off-centre. Calibrate using the spindle attachment, not the canvas centre.
No pedal, chain or bottom bracket; retain source pedal only if its attachment aligns.
